implementation_phases.coverage_gap: The mapped tests cover the shared kernel, statement journal, ledger, replay, calendar, and lineage primitives, but do not by themselves prove continuous exchange reconciliation or complete live decision-to-cash parity.

The mapped local implementation covers the full durable transport Cartesian matrix, crash-before/after lifecycle matrix, active config consensus across fresh Rust processes, accepted-timeout recovery for every placement path, independent stream reconnect/replay, active metadata mutation, complete reconciliation, and verified backup/restore. Credentialed exchange/account proof remains a separate promotion-evidence gate and is not inferred from local tests.
The mapped tests cover local routing, filters, capacity, and calibration equations; representative exchange cycles and holdout calibration are external evidence.
The mapped tests cover strategy equations and causality properties, not purged out-of-sample or live-shadow incremental value.
The mapped tests cover recovery components, not the required 30-day unattended soak and scheduled end-to-end injection campaign.
The mapped tests cover conservative allocation constraints, not shadow/paper/canary risk-adjusted lift.
The mapped tests cover research isolation and causality primitives; each extension still needs separate fault-contained OOS and canary evidence.

phase_promotion_gates.proof: Full clean CI; 100% decision/order/fill lineage in test sample; deterministic causal replay; economic ledger maps all sampled exchange fills/funding; daily unexplained cash/position difference no greater than exchange precision or $0.01.

Zero duplicate exchange effects and zero state invariant failures across fault suite and at least 1,000,000 randomized state-machine traces; every open order/position classified; no READY under mismatch; demonstrated backup restore.

At least 100 representative completed cycles; cost-model holdout median bias near zero, calibrated p90 coverage and MAPE below 15% in buckets with n>=100; adaptive routing non-inferior on total cost without worse hedge-risk SLO.

Purged OOS plus live shadow/paper positive incremental net decision value versus baseline after multiple-testing correction; positive rotation counterfactual value; stable calibration in at least three regimes.

30 consecutive unattended paper/testnet days; >=99.5% decision-service readiness excluding declared maintenance; zero critical reconciliation/invariant incidents; 100% injected gaps detected/replayed; >=95% routine auto-recovery within SLO; no unresolved alert.

At least 100 closed cycles and 30 actual funding settlements over >=30 days; 100% daily reconciliation; zero duplicate/orphan exposure; positive one-sided 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound on net expectancy; all preregistered guardrails satisfied.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Drop, duplicate and reorder each intent, ACK and exchange event.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: A Cartesian campaign covers all five durable command kinds, all five ACK states, and WORKING/PARTIAL/CANCEL_PENDING/FILLED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED/REJECTED updates on both spot and perpetual legs. Each kind is independently dropped, duplicated and reordered; durable replay follows producer sequence, monotonic ACK progress cannot regress or flip terminal truth, delayed exchange events are stale, and completion requires later authoritative reconciliation.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Kill Python/Rust before and after intent commit, REST submit, first fill, partial fill, cancel, hedge, terminal event and projection commit.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: The crash matrix reopens durable SQLite state before and after intent commit, REST SUBMITTED acknowledgement, and atomic lifecycle projection commit, and round-trips the shared cumulative-fill snapshot before and after first fill, later partial fill, verified cancel, residual hedge, and terminal reconciliation. Reapplying the boundary transition is idempotent and yields the identical state. Rust tests separately recover durable chase lineage and ambiguous cancel/underfill states without declaring completion.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Return REST timeout after the exchange accepted the order; prove read-before-retry and one exchange effect.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: A separate Python exchange emulator accepts each production order POST, withholds the HTTP response past the Rust client's bounded timeout, and serves authoritative same-client-ID queries. A real Rust process exercises spot limit, spot market, futures limit entry/exit, and futures market entry/exit; every path performs exactly one POST and one read-before-retry GET. Durable unknown-delivery reservations and command replay remain fail closed around that transport proof.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Disconnect market/private streams independently; expire listen keys; overflow telemetry; replay from durable cursor.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: A real Rust TCP/msgpack producer deliberately closes four independent connections while the production Python subscriber reconnects and observes market data, futures GAP/BACKFILLED cursor progress, spot listen-key expiry plus GAP/BACKFILLED progress, and a telemetry-overflow marker in order. Durable cursor monotonicity, structural two-stream quorum, truncated-history failure, and overflow-triggered replay controls are separately exercised inside the production recovery components.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Produce spot-only, perpetual-only, over-hedged, dust and exchange-only positions.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: A table-driven live-startup recovery test exercises spot-only, perpetual-only, over-hedged, below-cash-precision dust, and fully hedged exchange-only shapes through exchange-truth adoption, durable position projection, account-readiness publication, and manual-review classification. The cumulative-fill oracle separately proves overfills remain blocking evidence.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Change tick size, lot size, minimum notional, trading status and funding interval during an active cycle.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: A Python exchange emulator serves six successive paired spot/perpetual exchange-info snapshots to a real Rust process through the production REST/parser path. The same active Python order is revalidated as tick size, lot size, minimum notional, and trading status change, with each mutation producing the exact fail-closed reason; the restored snapshot coincides with an eight-to-four-hour funding-interval change in the production calendar. Rust actor coverage separately proves an active chase is preserved for reconciliation while readiness is revoked.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Inject 429/418/5xx, maintenance, clock skew and slow/hanging REST while fills continue.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: The local matrix covers 429/418, every 5xx class, maintenance and clock classification with bounded backoff. Rust actor tests prove authoritative private-fill progress while a REST future is blocked and prove a fill during a delayed spot submit triggers one urgent market hedge while suppressing the stale planned futures limit.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Exhaust spot balance, futures margin, borrow availability and repair reserve.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: The durable reservation model separately exhausts quote cash, futures margin, symbol-scoped spot borrowability, gross capacity, liquidation buffer, and protected repair/exit reserves. Inverse runtime dispatch rejects absent or stale borrow proof and admits only a fresh sufficient symbol budget; inverse production selection remains disabled.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Corrupt a projection, WAL and primary database; restore backup and rebuild from journal/exchange.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: The drill corrupts logical position/trade projections, rejects lifecycle hash tampering, and rebuilds deterministically only when journal replay matches authoritative exchange position identities. Separate primary and malformed-WAL cases require explicit replacement/quiescence/corruption authority, preserve forensic quarantine copies, restore a checksum/integrity-verified backup, and cannot use the corruption override against an active writer.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Run concurrent config writers, stale versions, invalid cross-field settings and Python/Rust hash disagreement.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: Atomic concurrent writers, stale/invalid reload rejection, canonical hashes, typed ACK handling, and hot-reload revocation are covered. A real Python producer launches fresh Rust OS processes with the production msgpack decoder and consensus code to prove restart fail-closed behavior, exact-hash application, declared/document hash disagreement rejection, invalid cross-field rejection, and preservation of the checked-in operator pause.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Keep heartbeat alive while the trading loop/event writer/reconciler is stuck; clear a port collision later.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: A combined watchdog campaign keeps aggregate liveness fresh while independently stalling liveness publication, maintenance/reconciliation, execution-event writing, and trading decisions; each forces a bounded trader restart. A missing progress map also fails closed. The same campaign trips a durable port-collision circuit and proves one bounded restart succeeds after the port clears and cooldown expires.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Restart with every safe-mode/cooldown/incident state and verify correct scope/acknowledgement.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: Every catalogued runtime safe-mode code plus unknown future codes round-trips from durable state; global and exact symbol blocks survive trader restart until explicitly cleared. Global and symbol cooldowns retain absolute expiry and scope. A reopen campaign covers OPEN, RECOVERING, WAITING, ACK_REQUIRED, EXHAUSTED, and RESOLVED incidents; interrupted claims retain their consumed attempt, become retryable or exhausted, preserve scope, and only proof-bearing ACK_REQUIRED incidents accept an identified operator acknowledgement.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Simulate funding sign reversal immediately before settlement, missed eligibility and a non-eight-hour interval.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: The exact lifecycle oracle uses filled-position windows, point-in-time rate revisions, and authoritative exchange statement IDs. A combined four-hour scenario proves a one-second pre-settlement sign reversal changes expected cash, future rate data is ignored, an after-settlement fill earns zero, and eligible funding remains unrealized until the exchange statement arrives.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Simulate flash volatility, book withdrawal, adverse partial fill, liquidation-margin compression and emergency reduce-only failure.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: One combined campaign applies flash drawdown and compressed available margin to the kill switch, withdraws the spot book while retaining a feasible perpetual-only emergency route, applies an adverse cumulative spot partial, derives the exact reduce-only perpetual residual, rejects that repair, and proves neither the execution oracle nor the live trader projects flatness. The durable position remains manual-review exposure with a cooldown and safe-mode flag.

failure_injection_matrix.requirement: Attempt to run treasury/dust logic against reserved hedge inventory and unrelated account orders.
failure_injection_matrix.coverage_gap: The legacy sweeper is permanently retired, direct invocation fails closed, the watchdog ignores its stale enable flag, and an integrated reconciliation-bound treasury test proves reserved inventory plus an external order yields a zero, non-executable proposal.
